Class DefaultJdkHttpClient

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.AbstractHttpClient<io.micronaut.http.client.jdk.JdkByteBodyResponse>
io.micronaut.http.client.jdk.DefaultJdkHttpClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
LifeCycle<HttpClient>, HttpClient, JdkHttpClient, SseClient, StreamingHttpClient, Closeable, AutoCloseable
@Internal public class DefaultJdkHttpClient extends AbstractHttpClient<io.micronaut.http.client.jdk.JdkByteBodyResponse> implements JdkHttpClient
HttpClient implementation for java.net.http.* HTTP Client. The filters, the redirects, the load balancing, the decoding of the responses, the streams and the asynchronous views are those of AbstractHttpClient; the JDK client sends one request.
Since:
4.0.0
Author:
Sergio del Amo

    • toAsyncStreaming

      public AsyncStreamingHttpClient toAsyncStreaming()
      Description copied from interface: StreamingHttpClient
      The AsyncStreamingHttpClient view of this client, with CompletionStage results and response bodies pulled one element at a time instead of Reactive Streams, including server-sent events. The default implementation adapts the reactive methods, and the server-sent events of SseClient.exchangeEventStream(HttpRequest, Argument, Argument) when this client is an SseClient.

    • sendBuffered

      protected ExecutionFlow<io.micronaut.http.client.jdk.JdkByteBodyResponse> sendBuffered(PropagatedContext propagatedContext, AtomicReference<ScheduledExecutorService> preferredScheduler, @Nullable Thread blockedThread, MutableHttpRequest<?> request, @Nullable LoadBalancerSelection selection, AtomicBoolean headersReceived)
      Description copied from class: AbstractHttpClient
      Send one request of an exchange whose response body is read whole, see AbstractHttpClient.readFullResponse(R, Argument, Argument, Function), without filters and without following redirects: a transport may read the body into memory right away. By default, see AbstractHttpClient.send(PropagatedContext, AtomicReference, Thread, MutableHttpRequest, LoadBalancerSelection).
      Overrides:
      sendBuffered in class AbstractHttpClient<io.micronaut.http.client.jdk.JdkByteBodyResponse>
      Parameters:
      propagatedContext - The context propagated from the original client call
      preferredScheduler - A reference holding the preferred scheduler for timeouts, which the transport may replace with the one of its connection
      blockedThread - The thread that blocks on the response, if any
      request - The request to send, with a resolved absolute URI
      selection - The selection of the load balancer for the request, or null
      headersReceived - Set by a transport that reads the body before the flow completes, once the response headers arrived: a timeout of the exchange then elapsed while the body was read
      Returns:
      The flow of the raw response
